## Key Features & Curriculum Design

The activity workbooks are purposefully designed as ready-to-use working materials for kindergartens, adapting to the developmental level of young children. The entire collection is structured across three distinct levels to ensure continuous progress:

*   **Little Group:** Each workbook includes 30 dedicated activity sheets.
*   **Middle Group:** Each workbook includes 30 dedicated activity sheets.
*   **Big Group:** Each comprehensive workbook contains 46 dedicated activity sheets.

Whether used in a classroom or at home, these workbooks offer engaging activities and games to enhance cognitive development while focusing on core communication skills. The curriculum has been officially approved by the MEN (Ministry of Education) through order 3022/08.01.2018.
